thread:
Maya Patel: quick heads-up — i'm landing a docs PR that renames one of our metering headers and updates the SDK examples + dashboard links. want a fast sanity check and a link pass before i merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 (private)

Tom Rivera: thanks — which header are we renaming? and is this a breaking change?

Maya Patel: old header is `X-Redwood-Usage`, new header will be `X-RW-Usage`. not breaking — we'll accept the old header as an alias for 3 weeks, documenting the deprecation in the migration notes. adding note in the PR.

Saanvi Rao: please add a short migration snippet in the Quickstart that shows both headers, and call out timeline (date) for removal. also add a short alert on the quota dashboard so customers see incoming traffic using the old header.

Eli Zhang: i can update the Grafana panels. need the PromQL change? what query are we using for per-tenant metering now?

Maya Patel: current per-tenant query is something like:

```
sum by (tenant) (increase(redwood_metered_tokens_total{header=~"(X-Redwood-Usage|X-RW-Usage)"}[30d]))
```

i updated the PR to use the regex so both headers show up during the transition. eli — if you want, i can push the panel JSON to your branch.

Eli Zhang: perfect, i'll pull that and tweak the panel titles to include "header migration" so support can find it. will also add a note in the panel description with the PR link.

Tom Rivera: can someone paste the minimal JS/TS SDK snippet we want in the docs? i'd rather copy that into the SDK samples repo as well.

Maya Patel: here's the small example i added in the PR:

```
// node fetch example
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RW_KEY}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'X-RW-Usage': 'tenant=acme,units=512'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({action: 'report'})
});
```

Maya Patel: comment in the snippet: if you still send `X-Redwood-Usage`, we'll accept it and map it to `X-RW-Usage` server-side for the transition period.

Saanvi Rao: also update the pricing/rate-tier doc blurb: mention that metered units map to billing tiers and that the header rename does not affect tier assignment. small copy tweak.

Tom Rivera: i'll do a quick run of the docs preview. Maya — can you drop the staging preview link here after CI finishes?

deploy-bot: CI passed — docs preview available at https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/changes/482 (expires in 7 days) :white_check_mark:

Maya Patel: preview link posted. i also added a short migration checklist in the PR description for support/solutions: migrate sample, update SDK examples, update dashboard links, send customer notice 1 week before enforcement.

Eli Zhang: pushed the panel JSON to `docs/482-grafana-panels.json` in the PR branch. left a small note about legend formatting.

Tom Rivera: quick nit — in the Quickstart sample, can we make the header example a table or code block with `curl` too? some users copy curl more than node.

Maya Patel: good call. added a `curl` snippet and a short `bash` example in the same file.

Saanvi Rao: leaving review now. :eyes: i'll approve once the curl snippet is in and the small copy tweak is done.

Maya Patel: thanks — aiming to merge after one more :thumbsup:. will post in #announcements when we schedule the alias removal.

docs-bot: scheduled reminder set for 3 weeks from merge date to remove alias header mapping. (automated)

Tom Rivera: :shipit:

Maya Patel: merging in 10m if no objections. thanks everyone!
